tasks.title: Implement the EMGI Measurement Envelope and missingness semantics
acceptance: Represent observed, partial, stale, not-collected, not-licensed, not-authorized, missing-unexpectedly, quarantined, source-error, truncated, and saturated states without coercing them to zero.
Separate value, observation count, coverage, freshness, uncertainty, negative-evidence validity, and source manifest.
Provide compatibility adapters that fail closed when legacy numeric-only rows are ambiguous.
Add exhaustive serialization, SQL mapping, and negative tests.
verification: uv run ruff check packages/schemas/emgi/measurement shared/domain/measurements.py tests/contract/test_emgi_measurement_envelope.py

tasks.title: Separate Provider, Dataset, DatasetVersion, ContractVersion, and Adapter identities
acceptance: Model provider organizations separately from concrete source datasets and releases.
Record schema version, release ID, endpoint/object URI, checksum, technical readiness, policy state, publication state, source role, and upstream dependencies.
Migrate metadata-only provider definitions without claiming live dataset readiness.
Reject duplicate dataset IDs, ambiguous versions, or adapters bound to an incompatible contract.
verification: uv run ruff check modules/external_data/domain/datasets.py modules/external_data/application/dataset_registry.py packages/schemas/emgi/datasets tests/contract/test_emgi_dataset_registry.py

tasks.title: Implement platform, shared, and tenant ingestion scope principals
acceptance: Represent owner, sharing, sensitivity, scope ID, and purpose grants as orthogonal dimensions.
Bind TENANT_PRIVATE fetches to authenticated tenant authority, GLOBAL_REFERENCE fetches to platform service authority, and LICENSED_SHARED fetches to a sharing group.
Prevent caller-supplied arbitrary scope and preserve tenant-qualified idempotency where required.
Prove GLOBAL, SHARED, and TENANT durable write/read isolation and restart readback.

tasks.title: Separate content blobs, observations, search executions, and retractions
acceptance: Deduplicate identical bytes while preserving repeated observations and last-seen evidence.
Record query geometry, filters, partition strategy, result limit, returned count, pagination exhaustion, saturation, source health, and completeness.
Implement explicit correction, retraction, and supersession without mutating raw evidence.
Provide idempotent run, content, observation, and publication identities as separate contracts.

tasks.title: Implement bitemporal, knowledge-time, and business-calendar contracts
acceptance: Separate event, effective, published, observed, fetched, ingested, available, knowledge, prediction-origin, label-maturity, retracted, and build times.
Add store timezone and business-day boundary; default Taiwan stores to Asia/Taipei.
Prohibit production materialization from silently defaulting as-of fields to current timestamp.
Prove midnight, DST-safe multi-market, month-boundary, and label-availability cases.
